name: kaggle-control-plane
description: Safely run, monitor, diagnose, and maintain Kaggle workloads through the local Kaggle Control Plane.

interface.shortDescription: Run and diagnose Kaggle jobs safely.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the local Kaggle Control Plane API for account and quota inspection, idempotent bounded batch submission, monitoring, cancellation, retry, artifact download, and safe support bundles. It also preserves local guidance for reproducible model benchmarks and desktop app maintenance. Kaggle credentials remain inside Control Plane. Lists owned datasets and archived results across accounts, records readback verification, and supports explicit owner-confirmed remote deletion. Validated research artifacts are proactively queued for private cloud archiving with full remote SHA-256 verification, restore metadata, and dependency-aware local cleanup under existing user authorization. Includes an opt-in global persistent archive queue that resumes transfer reconciliation and per-file checksum readback when the app reopens.
